title: lomatium humile
intro: Lomatium humile, commonly known as Small Lomatium or small desert parsley, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium humile are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
